metadata.description: Read-only skills for working with a local Windows Outlook (Classic) mailbox: status, search, threads, calendar, and .msg/.eml files.

plugins.name: outlook
plugins.description: Read-only Outlook (Classic) skills: guided setup, search (with attachments and fuzzy reranking), thread summaries, agenda and free slots, morning brief with follow-ups, meeting prep, .msg/.eml parsing, and a local memory with settings and a reply-habit profile. Never modifies the mailbox.
